chunks.title: Menu overview
chunks.content: Our menu features seasonal coastal cuisine with chef-led specials rotating weekly. Key dishes include Meyer Lemon Posset, Seared Scallops with citrus beurre blanc, and Pacific Halibut en papillote. The menu is divided into starters, mains, and desserts. Vegetarian and dietary-restricted options are available on request.

chunks.title: Private event dining
chunks.content: We host private events for groups of 10 to 60 guests. Our private dining room is available for corporate dinners, milestone celebrations, rehearsal dinners, and wine pairing evenings. Custom menus and AV arrangements are available. Submit a lead form to inquire and our events team will follow up within 24 hours.

chunks.title: Reservations
chunks.content: Reservations are recommended, especially on weekends. We accept bookings up to 30 days in advance. For same-day availability, call us directly or submit the reservation form on our site. Large parties of 8 or more require a 48-hour advance booking.

chunks.title: Meyer Lemon Posset
chunks.content: Meyer Lemon Posset is our signature dessert: a silky cream-set custard made with fresh Meyer lemons, finished with candied lemon zest and a shortbread crumble. It is gluten-adaptable on request. Priced at $14. Pairs well with our dessert wine selection.

chunks.title: Seared Scallops
chunks.content: Pan-seared day-boat scallops served with citrus beurre blanc, spring pea purée, and micro herbs. Available as a starter. Priced at $24. Sourced from local Pacific waters. Shellfish allergen warning applies.

chunks.title: Pacific Halibut en papillote
chunks.content: Wild Pacific halibut slow-roasted in parchment with heirloom tomatoes, olives, capers, and herbs. Served with a side of roasted fingerling potatoes. Priced at $38. Gluten-free and dairy-free. Available as a seasonal main.

chunks.title: Vegetarian and dietary options
chunks.content: We accommodate most dietary needs including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free. Please inform your server or note it in your reservation. Our kitchen will do its best to adjust dishes. Cross-contamination cannot be fully guaranteed for severe allergens.

chunks.title: Parking and location
chunks.content: We are located at 1 Coastal Drive, Demo Bay. Street parking is available on adjacent blocks. A public parking structure is located two blocks north. Valet is available Thursday through Sunday evenings. We are accessible via public transit: the 42 bus stops one block south.

chunks.title: Lead capture and contact form
chunks.content: You can submit a reservation request, event inquiry, or general question through our contact form. We typically respond within 24 hours. Fields include name, email, phone, intent (reservation, private event, general), and message. Your information is used only to respond to your inquiry.
